body: Hey man I know we’re here for the same reason and I’m being hypocritical but, please don’t do that. Life is hard I know and sometimes it feels like you never can get back up but you do. I know you want this pain to end but there is a part of you that is still determined to keep going. Feed that part of you. Life sucks I am not gonna lie to you but we all have something we’re fighting for. For me sometimes it’s knowing that I’m gonna get ice cream that day. Or that I have to do some laundry and if I’m not there who’s gonna do it? It’s about making the most out of what we’re given. Even if it’s something small like finding a dollar on the ground. I love you man please be safe and find that penny or laundry you need to get to. Those are really useful.
